apihelp-compasscurate-example: Highlight the wiki examplewiki on Special:Compass.
apihelp-compasscurate-param-curateaction: What to do with the listing.
apihelp-compasscurate-param-dbname: The database name of the wiki to act on.
apihelp-compasscurate-summary: Highlight, unhighlight or remove a wiki listing on Special:Compass.
apihelp-query+compass-example: Show all wikis on the form.
apihelp-query+compass-param-category: Filter by the CreateWiki defined category of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-customurl: Filter by if the wiki has a CreateWiki defined custom URL.
apihelp-query+compass-param-language: Filter by the CreateWiki defined language code of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-limit: Maximum number of results to show.
apihelp-query+compass-param-prop: Information to return about a defined wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-state: Filter by the CreateWiki defined state of a wiki.
apihelp-query+compass-param-wikis: Get a list of specific wikis.
apihelp-query+compass-summary: Get a list of wikis on a CreateWiki wikifarm.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-example: Show the first page of the wiki directory.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-cat: Only list wikis in this category.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-exc: Leave highlighted wikis out of the list.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-hig: Return the highlighted wikis instead of the directory.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-lan: Only list wikis in this language.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-sea: Only list wikis whose name or database name contains this text.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-sta: Only list wikis in this state.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-param-vis: Only list public or private wikis.
apihelp-query+compassdirectory-summary: Get the wikis listed on Special:Compass.
compass-action-delete: Accessible label of the button that removes a listing from Special:Compass.
compass-action-pin: Accessible label of the button that highlights a wiki on Special:Compass.
compass-action-unpin: Accessible label of the button that stops highlighting a wiki.
compass-button-reset:
Label for the button that clears every search filter on Special:Compass.
{{Identical|Reset}}
compass-card-more: Label of the accordion on a wiki card that expands to show the extended description.
compass-delete-body:
Body of the confirmation dialog shown before removing a listing. Parameters:
* $1 - the name of the wiki
compass-delete-confirm: Label of the destructive button in the removal confirmation dialog.
compass-delete-title: Title of the confirmation dialog shown before removing a listing.
compass-error-curate: Shown when a curation action failed.
compass-error-full:
Error shown when the configured maximum number of highlighted wikis is reached. Parameters:
* $1 - the maximum number of highlighted wikis
compass-error-load: Shown on Special:Compass when the directory could not be fetched.
compass-error-nowiki:
Error shown when the given database name does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the database name that was given
compass-error-thumbnail: Validation error for the thumbnail field in ManageWiki.
compass-filter-search: Label for the free text search field on Special:Compass.
compass-filter-search-placeholder: Placeholder text for the free text search field on Special:Compass.
compass-header: Accessible label of the search and filter region on Special:Compass.
compass-header-info: Introduction shown at the top of Special:Compass.
compass-highlights-heading: Heading shown above the pinned wiki cards on Special:Compass.
compass-label-description-help: Help text for the short description field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-extended-description: Label for the extended description field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-extended-description-help: Help text for the extended description field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-thumbnail: Label for the thumbnail field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-thumbnail-help: Help text for the thumbnail field in ManageWiki.
compass-label-visible: Label for the ManageWiki checkbox that controls whether a wiki is listed on Special:Compass.
compass-label-visible-help: Help text for the visibility checkbox in ManageWiki.
compass-loading: Accessible label of the progress bar shown while the directory loads.
compass-nojs: Shown on Special:Compass in place of the directory when the reader has JavaScript disabled.
compass-pagination-next: Label for the link to the next page of results on Special:Compass.
compass-pagination-previous: Label for the link to the previous page of results on Special:Compass.
compass-results-count:
Summary of the results currently shown on Special:Compass. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of the first result shown
* $2 - the number of the last result shown
* $3 - the total number of results
compass-results-empty: Shown on Special:Compass when no wiki matches the selected filters.
compass-results-heading: Heading shown above the paginated list of wikis on Special:Compass.
compass-sort-label:
Label for the sort order dropdown on Special:Compass.
{{Identical|Sort by}}
compass-sort-name:
Sort order option: alphabetical by wiki name.
{{Identical|Name}}
compass-sort-newest: Sort order option: most recently created wikis first.
compass-sort-oldest: Sort order option: oldest wikis first.
compass-sort-random: Sort order option: a shuffled order, so that browsing surfaces different wikis. This is the default.
compass-statistics-articles:
The number of content pages a wiki has, shown with an icon on its Special:Compass listing. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of articles
compass-statistics-edits:
The number of edits a wiki has had, shown with an icon on its Special:Compass listing. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of edits
compass-statistics-users:
The number of editors who have been active on a wiki in the last 30 days, shown with an icon on its Special:Compass listing. Parameters:
* $1 - the number of active editors
compass-table-actions:
Column header for the curation buttons on Special:Compass.
{{Identical|Action}}
randomwiki-header: Information text under legend header informing users what the page does.
randomwiki-parameters: Legend header in Special:RandomWiki asking users to insert parameters for their search.
